```{python}
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import os
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from sqlalchemy import create_engine

load_dotenv()
```


```{python}
data_dir = Path(os.environ["DATA_DIR"])
csv_path = data_dir / "air" / "Daily_County-Level_PM2.5_Concentrations_2001-2022_20260611.csv"
```


```{python}
df_raw = pd.read_csv(
    csv_path,
    dtype = {"year": int, "statefips": str, "countyfips": str, "pm25_max_pred": str}
)
```

### Data Transformations
- Add leading zeros to statefips and countyfips columns 
- concateonate statefips and countyfips columns to create county_id column
- Remove commas from pm25_max_pred column and convert data type to float
- combine all rows with the same county and year values into one row representing the average for that county in that year (do this for mean pred and max pred)
- update column names to reflect annual aggregation 
- compute the yearly standard deviation for each county for mean daily pred

```{python}
# add leading zeros to state and county fips codes
df_raw["statefips"] = df_raw["statefips"].astype(str).str.zfill(2)

df_raw["countyfips"] = df_raw["countyfips"].astype(str).str.zfill(3)
```

```{python}
# combind state and county fips codes to create county_id column
df_raw["county_id"] = df_raw["statefips"] + df_raw["countyfips"]
```

```{python}
# remove all commas from pm25_max_pred column
df_raw['pm25_max_pred'] = df_raw['pm25_max_pred'].str.replace(',', '')
df_raw["pm25_max_pred"] = df_raw["pm25_max_pred"].astype(float)
```

```{python}
# remove uneeded columns
df_raw = df_raw.drop(columns=["date", "statefips", "countyfips"])
```

```{python}
# aggregate all values to be average for a given county in a given year
df_final = df_raw.groupby(by=["year", "county_id"], as_index=False).mean()
```

```{python}
# update columns names to reflect applied annual aggregation
df_final = df_final.rename(columns={
    "pm25_max_pred": "pm25_max_daily_avg",
    "pm25_med_pred": "pm25_med_daily_avg",
    "pm25_mean_pred": "pm25_mean_daily_avg",
    "pm25_pop_pred": "pm25_pop_daily_avg"
})
```

```{python}
# calcuate annual standard deviation for each measure
df_sd = df_raw.groupby(by=["year", "county_id"], as_index=False).std()
```

```{python}
# update column names to reflect standard deviation calcuation
df_sd = df_sd.rename(columns={
    "pm25_max_pred": "pm25_max_sd",
    "pm25_med_pred": "pm25_med_sd",
    "pm25_mean_pred": "pm25_mean_sd",
    "pm25_pop_pred": "pm25_pop_sd"
})
```

```{python}
# merge sd columns into final_df
df_final = pd.merge(df_sd, df_final, on = ["year", "county_id"], how = "left")
```

```{python}
# remapping Oglala Lakota County code to fips standard
df_final.loc[df_final["county_id"] == "46113", "county_id"] = "46102"
```

```{python}
# setup connection variables to local sql db
database_url = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL")
engine = create_engine(database_url)
```

```{python}
# export cleaned data to sql table in local db
df_final.to_sql(
    "air_quality",
    con=engine,
    if_exists="replace",
    index=False
)
```
